Kill [[Pywatt the Swift]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Kill Pywatt the Swift in [[Alcazia Tangle]].
* *BONUS* Kill Pywatt the Swift in [[Hard Mode]].
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
* 1,000 [[Experience]]
* 500 [[Gold]]
* 500 [[Asura rank|Asura reputation points]]
* Complete the Base Objective for 20 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
* Complete the *BONUS* Objective for an additional 50 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Walkthrough==
The simplest way to reach Pywatt is to leave from [[Rata Sum]] via [[Magus Stones]]. Use the southeast portal to travel to Alcazia Tangle; Pywatt is just south of the portal in Alcazia Tangle.

==Notes==
Goes well with the quest [[Turning the Page]].
